title: OSPF ticket: configured, but no neighbor
summary: Use evidence to separate a local configuration check from a peer-topology problem.
brief: OSPF process 100 is configured with router ID 10.255.0.1 and network 10.0.0.0/8 in area 0, but an operator reports no neighbors. Collect local process, interface, and neighbor evidence in order. In this single-device simulator, an empty neighbor table is expected: do not claim an adjacency formed or make random configuration changes. Completion requires the evidence workflow, not an invented local repair.
hints: A configured routing process is not evidence of an adjacency.
Check local participation before interpreting the neighbor table.
An empty neighbor result is expected in this local-only model.

process_checks.label: Checked neighbor evidence and identified the remote-peer boundary

checks.label: Local OSPF process remains correctly configured
